description: US-38 The Übersichten tab and „Zu erledigen" on the Start screen. DF WANT MORE LISTS (certificates about to run out, cards not yet printed, reports later) AND THE LISTS THAT EXIST ARE SCATTERED: Karten neu ausstellen hangs off the Kunden hub, Ausgabetermine off the counter screen, neither has a tab. Before a third list arrives each gets a place. TWO KINDS OF LIST, TWO PLACES: a TO-DO (push — 'do I have to do something?') goes on the Start screen in a block „Zu erledigen", shown ONLY WHEN ITS COUNT IS ABOVE 0; an OVERVIEW (pull — 'I want to look something up') goes behind a NEW FIFTH NAV TAB „Übersichten", shown ALWAYS, 0 INCLUDED. RULES: every to-do has its home in Übersichten, not every overview is a to-do; only something a person can resolve, and which thereby returns to 0, is a to-do (Ausgabetermine never is); a to-do row links to the SAME page its tile does and the count comes from ONE use case, so Start and Übersichten can never disagree; a page belongs to exactly ONE tab and links from other screens are shortcuts. THIS BATCH MOVES WHAT EXISTS AND BUILDS NO NEW LIST: Ausgabetermine gets its home in Übersichten (the counter screen keeps its two links as shortcuts, what is counted does not change); Karten neu ausstellen is a tile in Übersichten AND a row in Zu erledigen (the Kunden hub keeps its link for now — a refinement decision, revisit after DF feedback); the Warteliste is untouched. THE URLS DO NOT MOVE (decided 29.09.2026): /ausgabetermine, /ausgabetermine/[id] and /karten-neuausstellung stay where they are, only the tab that marks them changes (active-section.ts). The requirement calls the second list 'Karten zur Neuausstellung'; the screen's heading is „Karten neu ausstellen" (de.cardsDue.heading) and THAT is what the tile and the row say — one wording of one list. NO SCHEMA CHANGE, NO NEW PORT METHOD, NOTHING IN src/domain/, NO AUDIT ENTRY (nothing writes), NO ADR. A story that finds itself in prisma/, src/infrastructure/, src/application/ports.ts or src/domain/ has misread the batch. Requirements: local_only/overviews-and-to-dos/requirement.md (+ ui-concept.md for the rules). Full PRD: tasks/prd-us-38-overviews-and-to-dos.md.
